request.style: English, female vocal, solo with soft choir, piano, strings, cello, gentle percussion, hopeful and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
People swear by someone greater than themselves
An oath serves as confirmation, settling the dispute
God showed the heirs of the promise his will
He guaranteed it with an oath, unchangeable and still

[Pre-Chorus]
Two unchangeable things, in which God cannot lie
We fled to him for refuge, we are not to say goodbye

[Chorus]
This hope we have as an anchor for the soul
Firm and secure, it holds us in control
It reaches within, behind the curtain
Where Jesus has entered, our safe harbor

[Verse]
He went on our behalf as the forerunner
A high priest forever, in a new order
The promise is clear, the path is known
His purpose is fixed, he is not alone

[Pre-Chorus]
Two unchangeable things, in which God cannot lie
We fled to him for refuge, we are not to say goodbye

[Chorus]
This hope we have as an anchor for the soul
Firm and secure, it holds us in control
It reaches within, behind the curtain
Where Jesus has entered, our safe harbor

[Bridge]
No dispute remains, the oath is true
The heirs of the promise see the way through
Encouragement is strong, we hold fast
Looking at the hope that is built to last

[Chorus]
This hope we have as an anchor for the soul
Firm and secure, it holds us in control
It reaches within, behind the curtain
Where Jesus has entered, our safe harbor

[Outro]
Anchored in the truth, we are free
His high priest forever, for me
